Ibulwako, ibulwako,

Ibulwako, ibulwako,
Onkolaki Masiya mpwe.

NYAMBE iyo otolondo

Bamboye nolnam'ane

Bakokundwama na Yesu,
Mbo i kala iowa.
Obayalie bee na Nkolo,

Obaungake na nguya,

N'o bobe mpe n'o boloti,
Obaekemeneke,
